theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the leader and sole eligible trend with momentum rank 1 (score 0.80) and one-narrative dominance. The lean is a trend-following continuation stance, not a return forecast. Durability is mixed (0.49) and breadth is narrow (0.30), so the trend is young and unconfirmed. Crowding is absent (z 0.39), which permits a modest directional lean without cap concerns.
theses.dissent: Coal's r10 is negative (-0.0327) and breadth is only 0.30, meaning recent returns are already fading and participation is thin—the theme may be exhausting its leadership rather than building it.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks show the strongest trend-health profile in the board: high durability (0.82), trend-tagged hurst, broad participation (0.833). Momentum rank 2 (score 0.757) is only modestly below leader. Crowding is flagged (z 1.83), which per guardrails is a size-down caution, not a fade signal—so the lean stays directional but restrained.
theses.dissent: Crowding z 1.83 is high and the theme is already a crowded trend; momentum rank-IC is ~0 on this universe, so the broad participation may simply mark a late-stage consensus top rather than durable leadership.

This is not a fade/short—just an absence of directional conviction.
